name: Get a taste of your own medicine

meaning.zh:
“自尝其果”，或者说 “自食其果”。

这个短语源于古代希腊寓言中被人骗去吃了自己配置的毒药的医生。现在，它被用来形容一个人被以他自己对待别人的方式回报，被迫体验到自己曾经强加给他人的困境或不快。
meaning.en: The phrase originates from an ancient Greek fable where a doctor was tricked into eating his own poisoned medicine. Today, it is used to describe a situation where someone is forced to experience the same unpleasantness or harm they once inflicted on others.

lines.en: After bullying others for years, he finally *got a taste of his own medicine* when he was mocked by his classmates.
lines.zh: 在多年来欺负别人后，当他被同学嘲笑时，终于自尝其果。

lines.en: She always interrupts others, but she *got a taste of her own medicine* when someone interrupted her speech.
lines.zh: 她总是打断别人，但当有人打断她的演讲时，她终于自食其果。

lines.en: The corrupt official *got a taste of his own medicine* when he was betrayed by his own allies.
lines.zh: 当那名腐败官员被自己的盟友背叛时，他自尝其果。
